messages:
nina: Quick report - onboarding sample app caused duplicate writes when a 429 hit at the same time auth refreshed. Customers hit this twice.
omar: Classic. sample app replays immediately after refresh with no idempotency key or jitter.
kevin: Can we update the sample to show a safe pattern? e.g. set Idempotency-Key for create calls and add tiny jitter on replay.
nina: sanitized log: 
2026-03-29T12:02:10Z auth: refresh:start
2026-03-29T12:02:10Z api: 429 route=/v1/createTicket
2026-03-29T12:02:10Z auth: refresh:done
2026-03-29T12:02:10Z client: replaying request immediately
2026-03-29T12:02:10Z api: ticket created id=tkt_01
2026-03-29T12:02:10Z api: ticket created id=tkt_02
kevin: Suggestion: SDK add config `replayProtection` with default 'jitter' and modes ['compat','jitter','strict']. In 'jitter' add randomized 20-200ms delay when replaying after refresh and emit `replay_suspect=true` in structured logs.
omar: Docs/sampleapp change to show header example and explain streaming vs non-streaming caveats. Also add a small CI test that simulates 429+refresh and asserts single side-effect.
ci-bot: Created ticket DX-371234 "onboarding dup writes - refresh race".
nina: I'll open sampleapp PR today. Omar, can you take SDK PR? Kevin add docs blurb.
kevin: on it. no objections. :thumbsup:
